META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml.text:
modLoader="javafml" #mandatory
loaderVersion="[2,)" #mandatory
license="All rights reserved"

[[mods]] #mandatory
modId="integrated_villages" #mandatory
logoFile="../assets/integrated_villages/integrated_villages_logo.png"
    logoBlur=false
    version="1.3.3+1.21.1-neoforge" #mandatory
    displayName="Integrated Villages" #mandatory
displayURL="https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/integrated-villages"
    authors="CraisinLord"
    description='''
    Adds integration and drastically improves Minecraft Villages!
    '''
[[mixins]]
    config = "integrated_villages-common.mixins.json"

[[dependencies.integrated_villages]]
    modId="minecraft"
    type="required"
    versionRange="[1.21.1,)"

[[dependencies.integrated_villages]]
    modId="integrated_api"
    type="required"
    versionRange="[1.6.2,)"
    ordering="AFTER"
    side="BOTH"

[[dependencies.integrated_villages]]
    modId="create"
    mandatory=true
    versionRange="*"

[[dependencies.integrated_villages]]
    modId="supplementaries"
    mandatory=true
    versionRange="*"
